material_selection_reason: Discovery and native reproduction already froze one exact test-only lifecycle boundary. The coordinator holds the complete local test-envelope context, the correction is a few mechanical lines in one file, and decisive focused/full self-checks cannot expose environment values to an external worker. A separate worktree/worker handoff would cost more than the bounded change while adding no independent discovery value. Fresh review remains delegated after candidate freeze.

deepseek-v4-pro: Repository write and native runtime verification with environment values are outside the qualified external route.
ox-alpha: Current availability is degraded and repository write/runtime qualification is not stronger than native.
native-luna: The edit is cheap, but worktree transfer and test-envelope reconstruction remove the cost advantage.
native-terra: No concrete current advantage over the coordinator's exact reproduced boundary.
native-sol-worker: Permissible, but isolation overhead exceeds this one-file low-consequence edit; independence is reserved for the post-freeze no-repair gate.

access_boundary.readable: reference-gating.test.ts, real createApp lifecycle, neighboring test precedent, and recorded reproduction evidence
access_boundary.forbidden: production source, every other test, config, environment schemas/values, timeout inflation, retry, skip, mock, reduced assertion coverage, unrelated debt, and further delegation
